description: Let players sign in with a portal or federated account via player.loginExternal({ provider, token }). Self-serve providers: 'wavedash' (games on wavedash.com; token = (await Wavedash.getUserJwt()).data) and 'google' (Google Identity Services; token = the GIS ID-token credential). The server verifies every token against fixed, provider-published keys; you only supply public pins. wavedash: gameId is required = the gcid of the Wavedash game players sign in from (ask the user, or read claims.gcid off a token with verify_login_token, which works before wavedash is enabled). Playtest and production builds have different gcids: re-run with the production one before launch. google: clientId is required. Re-run to change the config (e.g. once the game id is known). Then verify with verify_login_token.

clientId.description: google only: the OAuth client id (…apps.googleusercontent.com).

game.description: Which game to act on: its publishable key (pk_…) or its exact name. Defaults to the x-mp-game header, then your primary game.

gameId.description: wavedash (required): the Wavedash game id, pinned against the token's gcid claim.

name: enable_login_provider
title: Enable a portal / federated login
